text: Quick one: how long do we wait before an unacknowledged page goes to the secondary?
We agreed in the platform sync to tighten it. The primary now has 20 minutes to acknowledge, then the page goes to the secondary. The handbook has not caught up yet.
Thanks, I will follow that until the policy page is updated.
Is the old VPN really gone? My client still shows it.
Yes. Use the access proxy with the device-posture check. The VPN profile is being removed from laptops this month.
Can I ship the config change on Friday afternoon? It is tiny.
Please do not. We avoid Friday deploys, and the on-call has to babysit anything that goes out. Ship Monday morning.
Do certificate renewals really still happen 30 days out? PLAT-230 says 21.
The automation is still on the old window until the change lands. Treat the ticket as the plan and the runbook as what runs today.
Staging reset happens every Sunday night, so push your test data before then.
